items.claim: CEO 表示 2026 營收成長預測由 2 月 >20%、5 月 >30% 一路上調，目前接近 40%
items.quote: Now we're approaching 40% revenue growth
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱 2026 年 WFE 成長的 80% 來自先進邏輯代工、DRAM（含 HBM）與先進封裝，2027 年起同樣結構
items.quote: 80% of wafer fab equipment growth this year
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明客戶提供滾動八季預測與較長期承諾
items.quote: rolling 8-quarter forecast and longer-term commitments
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱與客戶的討論已延伸到 2030 年
items.quote: discussions with customers all the way through 2030
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 指 Agentic AI 推高長期 WFE 預測，尤其是 CPU 與 DRAM
items.quote: driving increase in our longer-term WFE forecast
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 以先進製程晶圓起量比例說明資料中心需求：未來兩年資料中心對智慧手機達 2:1
items.quote: it will be 2:1 data center versus smartphone
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 回應是否有循環頂部警訊時，強調需求的廣度
items.quote: I've never seen a driver that's as broad and pervasive
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示不花時間擔心短期總體因素
items.quote: I don't really spend time worrying about macro effects
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 承認可能出現成長放緩的階段，但稱多年趨勢明確
items.quote: are there going to be periods of time where it's not growing
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: 被問及客戶的客戶靠資本市場融資支撐資本支出時，CEO 表示不太擔心
items.quote: I don't worry so much about what you just talked about
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱服務業務年增逾 20%，服務毛利率提升 180 個基點
items.quote: Margins are up 180 basis points
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 給出半導體系統毛利率口徑：約五十幾％中段，一年增加約 190 個基點
items.quote: our semi systems gross margin is in the mid-50s
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 對毛利率持續上升表達高度信心（未給數字）
items.quote: I have very high confidence we're going to continue
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱改採不同服務合約時，每台設備營收可超過加倍
items.quote: we can more than double revenue per tool
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱現場已有逾 3.7 萬個腔體連接至 AI 伺服器
items.quote: over 37,000 chambers in the field today
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱 AI 內部運用主要在營收成長；會增加人力，營收成長快很多倍
items.quote: we will add headcount, but we're going to grow revenue
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱客戶遷往新地區是服務業務的順風
items.quote: the regionalization is a tailwind for us in our service business
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: 被問 Terrafab 時，CEO 表示不談任何特定客戶
items.quote: I'm not going to talk about any specific customer
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱中國與整體 ICAPS 今年成長，並在可競爭領域小幅取得份額
items.quote: we're seeing growth this year in China and overall ICAPS
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 給 ICAPS 長期成長口徑為中至高個位數
items.quote: ICAPS grows at kind of mid- to high single digits
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱明年 ICAPS 成長會比今年略快，但仍慢於資料中心相關
items.quote: Next year, we see that business also growing a little bit faster
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 對 2027 給定性說法，不給具體數字
items.quote: '27 is going to be a great year for Applied
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱 2027 之後成長將非常強勁
items.quote: beyond '27, growth is going to be very strong
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱先進封裝業務今年預計成長逾 70%，規模約 20～30 億美元中點
items.quote: is forecasted to grow over 70% this year
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱檢測量測業務本曆年成長逾 50%
items.quote: our inspection measurement business is growing over 50% this calendar year
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱在電子束技術上領先業界幅度大
items.quote: Applied is the leader in the industry by a large amount
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱在晶片與封裝的材料創新上規模遠大於最近的競爭對手
items.quote: Applied is much larger than our nearest competitor
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱過程控制中 e-beam 與光學兩類技術今年皆成長逾 50%
items.quote: growing at a very fast pace, over 50% this year
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示將把 80%～100% 現金回饋股東
items.quote: We'll return 80% to 100% of cash to shareholders
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱地緣政治環境下大型併購不可能
items.quote: it's just not possible to do large M&A
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 提及近期小型併購：面板級電鍍公司
items.quote: We just acquired a company in panel-level plating
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 提及另一筆 X 光技術小型併購
items.quote: We acquired another company with X-ray technology
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 提及混合鍵合的策略性投資，結合夥伴技術與應用材料五項技術
items.quote: combining a partner technology with 5 technologies
items.speaker: Gary Dickerson (CEO)

qa_flags.question: 2027 年成長是否優於 2026 年（定性評估）
qa_flags.response_pattern: 只說 2027 會 strong、不給具體數字，且未直接比較 2027 與 2026 的成長快慢

qa_flags.question: 是否看到成長延續到 2028 年
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未直接回答 2028，改談算力需求與 Agentic／實體 AI 的整體論述

qa_flags.question: 記憶體是否持續領先成長，或何時由先進邏輯代工接手
qa_flags.response_pattern: 拒絕排序（I don't know I want to handicap one versus the other），也不給數字

qa_flags.question: 與 Terrafab 的技術與商業合作程度及市場地位
qa_flags.response_pattern: 不談特定客戶，改答對所有客戶的合作與產品組合
